_comment: Synthetic evaluation cases for P02. Every part number here is invented; there is no real supplier, catalogue or price anywhere in this project. Each case is one call across the MCP boundary and the assertions it must satisfy. The last case is a canary: it asserts something known to be false, and the suite fails if it PASSES.

cases.name: a stocked part reports its count and is not below reorder
a part at or under its reorder point says so
an empty shelf is a number, not a missing part
an unknown part is refused by name and offers what is known
a query that matches nothing returns an empty list, not an error
a partial number matches every part that carries it
a bin is a place somebody can walk to
CANARY: this assertion is false on purpose
